Name: BTS Light Sticks by Mint
Author: mintshelle
Description:
Hi Army! ♡

I made this mod for you to show your love of BTS to the entire Valley.
There are two different versions of the light sticks: one with a shelf, and one without. The light sticks will glow purple after the sun sets in game.

Alternative Textures is required! ♡

» other furniture mods pictured are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14644]West Elm Furniture[/url]
